messages:
eva: Quick heads-up — we've opened a small Dedicated mi300 pool in Canada East (ca-central). This is a soft launch for reserved customers + burst testing. Please read the notes below before attaching workloads.

ryan: Nice! Do we have the initial capacity numbers and pricing for the reserved slots?

eva: Initial pool: 8 mi300 instances reserved for Dedicated. Burst pool: +4 on best-effort for eligible accounts. Pricing for reserved capacity follows the existing MI300 tier rate (contact sales for committed discount). Public quota opens later this quarter.

ops-bot: [capacity-update] Pool created: 8 reserved + 4 burst in ca-central-1 at 2024-11-20T10:06:29Z. Reservation endpoint: https://console.redwood.ai/dedicated/reservations

sasha: For folks running latency-sensitive workloads: SLO target is 99th pct < 120ms for typical gen workloads. If you need lower p99s, tag your rollout and we can prioritize on-call routing.

eva: Important policy points: 1) Burst capacity is best-effort and may be reclaimed during peak; 2) Customers must pin model versions when on reserved MI300 to avoid cross-variant runtime issues; 3) Private deployments require separate onboarding — this pool is hosted Dedicated only.

clare: What about fallback behavior if the pool is depleted? Can we auto-fallback to L40s in us-east with cross-region routing?

eva: Yes — default route policy will failover to l40s-us-east (cross-region) with a cost bump. If you want in-account routing changes, set a custom routing policy in the console or file a support ticket.

ryan: Any known ops caveats? GPU drivers/quantization differences?

eva: MI300 kernel + ROCm 6.x. We recommend validating quantized checkpoints (int8/4) in staging; some older ops/layernorm kernels behave slightly differently — report regressions to eng-ml.

ops-bot: Reminder: To reserve capacity use the CLI: ```redwood dedicated reserve --region ca-central-1 --model mi300 --count 1 --term monthly``` Reservations are subject to approval.

eva: Launch tasks: - platform: watch pool utilization during first 72h - sales: notify committed customers in Canada - docs: publish quickstart + migration notes (ETA 24h)

sasha: I'll add a short note to the latency dashboard and a canary test against mi300 in CA.

eva: Thanks all. If you need to trial a spot of MI300 in CA for performance evaluation, DM me and I'll open a temporary dev reservation. :rocket:
